exam_scheme.note: Under JKSSB selection criteria, recruitment comprises two sequential stages: Stage 1 Computer Based Type Test (Qualifying, minimum 35 wpm with 90% accuracy), Stage 2 Written Examination (80 marks, 80 minutes), followed by Stage 3 Document Verification. Negative marking in the written test is 0.25 marks per incorrect answer.

stages.source_label: JKSSB Type Test Directives & Evaluation Protocol

papers.paper_name: Computer Typing Speed Test (English Keyboard Typing)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 35 words per minute (wpm) with minimum 90% accuracy required to qualify for written test

stages.source_label: JKSSB Junior Assistant Written Exam Scheme & Syllabus

papers.paper_name: General Awareness with special reference to JK UT (History, Geography, Current Affairs, Reorganisation Act)
Basic Concepts of Computers (Architecture, Windows, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Internet)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Single composite paper of 80 marks / 80 minutes; merit determines final cadre allocation

papers.paper_name: Scrutiny of Bachelor's Degree Certificate, Computer Typing Qualification Certificate, Domicile & Category Documents

financial_package.note: Junior Assistants are appointed in Pay Matrix Level 4 (₹25,500–₹81,100 with Entry Basic Pay ₹25,500) under the Jammu and Kashmir Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules (S.O. 192 of 2020).
financial_package.pay_source_label: J&K Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules Schedule Level 4
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 4 entry basic pay of ₹25,500 at 58% DA (₹14,790 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 18%: ₹2,295 to ₹4,590 for district headquarters and Civil Secretariat Jammu/Srinagar), Medical Allowance (₹300), Transport Allowance (₹900 + DA = ₹1,422), net of NPS deduction (10% of Basic+DA = ₹4,029) and State Insurance.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually aligned with central rates
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by district / Secretariat posting
Cashless medical facility under Ayushman Bharat SEHAT for employees and dependants
Computer allowance and secretariat duty incentive where applicable
Defined contribution pension coverage under National Pension System (NPS)
Standard 3% annual basic increment in Pay Matrix Level 4
